message.content:
Ableton Live 12 Suite includes a large set of **factory Packs** and **stock devices**; most of what you listed is included, but a few items are separate paid products.

---

## 1. Which of these Packs are included with Live 12 Suite?

Ableton’s own Live 12 help page “Updated Factory Packs in Live 12” lists the **factory Packs** that ship with Live 12 (i.e. included with Standard and Suite, not paid add‑ons).[1] Among your list, the following are confirmed there as **included Packs**:

- **Inspired by Nature** – explicitly listed as an updated factory Pack in Live 12.[1]  
- **Skitter and Step** – explicitly listed as a factory Pack.[1]  
- **Drive and Glow** – explicitly listed as a factory Pack.[1]  
- **Beat Tools** – explicitly listed as a factory Pack.[1]  

That same Ableton help page groups these with other “Factory Packs in Live 12” such as Build and Drop, Chop and Swing, Glitch and Wash, Punch and Tilt, Drone Lab, Mood Reel, Voice Box, orchestral Packs, etc., indicating they are part of the standard Live 12 library, not separate paid products.[1]

### Surreal Machines “Dub Machines” (Diffuse and Magnetic)

- Ableton’s product page for **Dub Machines** describes it as a Max for Live Pack sold for **USD 39**, with requirements “Live 11 Standard & Max for Live (version 11.1 or higher)” and “Max for Live.”[2]  
- Ableton’s “Packs by Surreal Machines” page also treats Dub Machines as a separate Pack by a third‑party developer.[12]

There is no indication on ableton.com that Dub Machines is bundled with Live 12 Suite; the explicit price and requirements show it is a **paid add‑on Pack**, not part of the Suite license.[2][12]

### Bark of Dog

- There is no Ableton Pack on ableton.com called **Bark of Dog**; that name corresponds to a well‑known third‑party low‑frequency enhancer plugin, not an official Ableton Pack.  
- Since it does not appear in Ableton’s “Updated Factory Packs in Live 12” list and has no Ableton Pack page, it is **not** a Live 12 Suite Pack.[1]

**Summary of Pack status (Live 12 Suite, as of 2024–2025, based on Ableton sources):**

| Pack / product                           | Included with Live 12 Suite? | Evidence from ableton.com |
|------------------------------------------|------------------------------|---------------------------|
| **Inspired by Nature**                   | **Included factory Pack**    | Listed in “Updated Factory Packs in Live 12”.[1] |
| **Skitter and Step**                     | **Included factory Pack**    | Listed in “Updated Factory Packs in Live 12”.[1] |
| **Drive and Glow**                       | **Included factory Pack**    | Listed in “Updated Factory Packs in Live 12”.[1] |
| **Beat Tools**                           | **Included factory Pack**    | Listed in “Updated Factory Packs in Live 12”.[1] |
| **Surreal Machines Dub Machines**        | **Paid add‑on Pack**         | Separate Pack page with USD 39 price; requires Live + Max for Live.[2][12] |
| **Diffuse** and **Magnetic** (in Dub Machines) | **Part of paid Dub Machines Pack** | Described as the two Max for Live devices in Dub Machines.[2][15] |
| **Bark of Dog**                          | **Not an Ableton Pack**      | Not listed among Ableton Packs or factory Packs.[1] |

---

## 2. Which of your listed devices are stock Live 12 Suite devices?

Retail and informational pages summarizing **Ableton Live 12 Suite** instruments and effects (based on Ableton product specs) list the core devices included in Suite, including the ones you asked about.[5][7][8][11] Ableton’s own “Instruments and Effects” page further highlights which are **new in Live 12**.[13]

From these:

### Confirmed stock instruments/effects in Live 12 Suite

- **Roar** – listed among the audio effects included with Live 12 Suite (“58 audio effects … including Roar, Hybrid Reverb, Spectral Time and Spectral Resonator”).[5][7][8][11] Ableton’s “Instruments and Effects” page also presents Roar as a **new in Live 12** device.[13]  
- **Spectral Resonator** – specifically named as an included audio effect in Live 12 Suite.[5][7][8][11]  
- **Spectral Time** – likewise listed as one of the included audio effects.[5][7][8]  
- **Collision** – listed among the 20 instruments included with Live 12 Suite.[5][7][8][10][11]  
- **Drift** – listed as one of the Suite instruments.[5][7][8][10][11]  
- **Meld** – listed as a Suite instrument and featured as “New in Live 12” on Ableton’s instruments/effects page.[5][7][8][10][11][13]  
- **Granulator III** – listed explicitly among Suite instruments and highlighted as “New in Live 12” by Ableton.[5][7][8][10][11][13]  

### Devices that are standard Live devices/effects

- **Corpus** – Ableton documents Corpus as one of the physical modeling/FX devices in Live; it is part of the Suite effects set (historically bundled with Suite’s instruments/effects). While the 12‑Suite summary pages focus on headline names, Corpus is part of the **stock Suite audio effects collection**.[11]  
- **Resonators** – similarly, Resonators is an existing Live audio effect; like Corpus it lives within the standard audio effects set available in Suite.[11]

Ableton’s PDF‑style description for Live 12 Suite states that Suite includes “20 instruments, including Meld, Granulator III, Wavetable, Simpler and more [and] 74 effects for processing Audio and MIDI, including Roar, Hybrid Reverb, Spectral Resonator, PitchLoop89, the new Performance Pack and many more,” which implicitly covers long‑standing effects such as Corpus and Resonators.[11]

**Summary of device status (Live 12 Suite):**

| Device              | Type                 | Included in Live 12 Suite? | Ableton evidence |
|---------------------|----------------------|----------------------------|------------------|
| **Roar**            | Audio effect         | **Included**               | Listed among Suite audio FX; “New in Live 12” on Ableton instruments page.[5][7][8][11][13] |
| **Spectral Resonator** | Audio effect      | **Included**               | Named in Suite FX list.[5][7][8][11] |
| **Spectral Time**   | Audio effect         | **Included**               | Named in Suite FX list.[5][7][8][11] |
| **Corpus**          | Audio effect         | **Included** (Suite FX set) | Part of Live’s stock audio effects; covered within “74 effects … and many more” for Suite.[11] |
| **Resonators**      | Audio effect         | **Included** (Suite FX set) | Stock audio effect included in Suite’s full FX collection.[11] |
| **Collision**       | Instrument           | **Included**               | Listed among 20 Suite instruments.[5][7][8][10][11] |
| **Drift**           | Instrument           | **Included**               | Listed among Suite instruments.[5][7][8][10][11] |
| **Meld**            | Instrument           | **Included; new in Live 12** | Listed as instrument; “New in Live 12” on Ableton instruments page.[5][7][8][10][11][13] |
| **Granulator III**  | Instrument           | **Included; new in Live 12** | Listed as instrument; featured as “New in Live 12.”[5][7][8][10][11][13] |

---

If you want, I can help you derive a practical “install list” (which Packs/devices to make sure are downloaded) for a fresh Live 12 Suite installation based strictly on Ableton’s factory Pack list.
